node_kinds.name: LLMHound_CollectionVantage
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: configured scanner/network context from which observations were made. Not an attacker principal.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_NetworkEndpoint
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: fallback node for an observed IP/FQDN target that did not correlate to an existing AD Computer.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_OllamaInstance
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: fingerprinted Ollama service endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_MCPServer
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: fingerprinted Model Context Protocol server endpoint.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_MCPTool
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: tool advertised by an MCP server.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_AIModel
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: model served or advertised by an AI service.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_AIService
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: umbrella label intended as an extra kind on concrete service nodes; carries no identity of its own.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_M0UpsertProbe
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: probe node for upsert/rescan behavior tests. Spike-only kind, not part of the real graph model.

node_kinds.name: LLMHound_M0TraversableProbe
node_kinds.description: M0 spike only: node kind used by the traversability control edge. Spike-only kind, not part of the real graph model.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ObservedAt
relationship_kinds.description: M0 spike only: fingerprinted service was observed through this target (correlated Computer or fallback NetworkEndpoint).

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_UnauthenticatedAccess
relationship_kinds.description: M0 spike only: a specific enumeration operation succeeded without credentials from the recorded vantage.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ProvidesModel
relationship_kinds.description: M0 spike only: model advertised by the runtime; inference not implied.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_ProvidesTool
relationship_kinds.description: M0 spike only: tool enumerated, not executed.

relationship_kinds.name: LLMHound_M0TraversableControl
relationship_kinds.description: M0 spike only: traversability CONTROL edge (is_traversable true) so pathfinding behavior can be contrasted against the non-traversable LLMHound kinds. Spike-only kind; the real LLMHound schema ships no traversable edges.
